messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
I don’t have a built‑in function that pulls holiday calendars from an external API, but I can give you the standard long‑weekend dates for Canada in 2023. These are the federal public holidays that typically create a three‑day weekend (or longer if they fall on a weekday). If you need province‑specific holidays or a more detailed calendar, you might want to consult a dedicated holiday‑API or the official government website for each province.

| Date | Holiday | Notes |
|------|---------|-------|
| **January 1** | New Year’s Day | 2023‑01‑01 (Sunday) – observed 2023‑01‑02 (Monday) |
| **January 16** | Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | 2023‑01‑16 (Monday) |
| **February 20** | Louis Riel Day (Manitoba) | 2023‑02‑20 (Monday) |
| **March 20** | St. Patrick’s Day (Newfoundland & Labrador) | 2023‑03‑20 (Monday) |
| **April 7** | Good Friday | 2023‑04‑07 (Friday) – creates a long weekend (Fri‑Sun) |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day (all provinces) | 2023‑05‑22 (Monday) |
| **June 19** | National Indigenous Peoples Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, Ontario) | 2023‑06‑19 (Monday) |
| **July 1** | Canada Day | 2023‑07‑01 (Saturday) – observed 2023‑07‑03 (Monday) |
| **September 18** | Labour Day (all provinces) | 2023‑09‑18 (Monday) |
| **October 9** | Thanksgiving (all provinces) | 2023‑10‑09 (Monday) |
| **November 7** | Remembrance Day (all provinces) | 2023‑11‑07 (Monday) |
| **December 25** | Christmas Day | 2023‑12‑25 (Monday) |
| **December 26** | Boxing Day | 2023‑12‑26 (Tuesday) |

### How to use this in your app
1. **Store the dates** in a database or a JSON file that your holiday‑planning module can read.
2. **Mark the days** as “public holiday” and flag the adjacent weekend days as “long weekend” if they fall on a Friday or Monday.
3. **Add province‑specific logic** if you want to support users in provinces that have extra holidays (e.g., Family Day in BC, Louis Riel Day in Manitoba, etc.).

If you need a programmatic way to pull this data, you could use a holiday‑API such as [date.nager.at](https://date.nager.at/Api) or the Canadian government’s open data portal. Those services typically expose endpoints like:

```
GET https://date.nager.at/api/v3/PublicHolidays/2023/CA
```

which will return a JSON array of all federal holidays for Canada in 2023. You can then filter or map the results to your own data model.

Let me know if you’d like help writing code to consume such an API or if you need province‑specific holiday lists!
